lessons.title: الحصة الأولى: المضارع البسيط المثبت مع المفرد (Present Simple Affirmative)
lessons.caption: 🎬 فيديو الحصة الأولى - الصف الثالث ثانوي | مستر مازن (eShool)
lessons.introMessage: يا هلا بيك! الحصة الأولى عن المضارع البسيط في الجملة المثبتة مع المفرد، وحنركز فيها على إضافة s للفعل. برسل ليك الفيديو والتمرين هسي 👇
lessons.taskMessage:
📝 *تمرين الحصة الأولى (Task 1): Present Simple — Affirmative with Singular Subjects*

كمّل كل جملة بكتابة الصيغة الصحيحة للفعل في الفراغ. الفعل الأساسي موجود بين القوسين. انتبه: كل الجمل مثبتة، والفاعل مفرد، وكل الأفعال هنا بتاخد *s* فقط.

1. The analyst __________ (interpret) the survey results before presenting them.
2. A responsible engineer __________ (maintain) the equipment regularly.
3. The report __________ (reflect) the most recent findings.
4. The research team __________ (conduct) a detailed investigation.
5. This device __________ (transmit) data securely to the control center.
6. The international market __________ (demand) reliable products.
7. A local journalist __________ (report) important developments accurately.
8. The consultant __________ (recommend) a practical solution to the problem.
9. The new policy __________ (permit) students to use the library after school.
10. The experienced analyst __________ (predict) changes in consumer behavior.
11. Regular practice __________ (benefit) every language learner.
12. The manager __________ (confirm) the final schedule with the staff.

✍️ رسل لي إجاباتك مرقّمة من 1 إلى 12 عشان أراجعها ليك.
answerKey: 1. interprets — A singular subject; add -s.
2. maintains — A singular subject; add -s.
3. reflects — A singular subject; add -s.
4. conducts — A singular subject; add -s.
5. transmits — A singular subject; add -s.
6. demands — A singular subject; add -s.
7. reports — A singular subject; add -s.
8. recommends — A singular subject; add -s.
9. permits — A singular subject; add -s.
10. predicts — A singular subject; add -s.
11. benefits — A singular subject; add -s.
12. confirms — A singular subject; add -s.

lessons.title: الحصة 3 Present Simple - Singular - the verb ends in -y
lessons.caption: 🎬 فيديو الحصة 3 Present Simple - Singular - the verb ends in -y | مستر مازن (eShool)
lessons.introMessage: يا هلا بيك! دي الحصة: الحصة 3 Present Simple - Singular - the verb ends in -y. برسل ليك الفيديو والتمرين هسي 👇
lessons.taskMessage:
1. Ahmed __________ English every evening. (study)
2. My mother __________ delicious meals for our family. (enjoy)
3. The baby __________ whenever he is hungry. (cry)
4. She __________ her homework before dinner. (finish?)
5. My father __________ to work every morning. (drive)
6. The teacher __________ the students with their assignments. (help)
7. He __________ his room every Saturday. (tidy)
8. The little boy __________ his toys with his friends. (share)
9. A good student __________ hard before an exam. (study)
10. My brother __________ his bicycle to school every day. (carry)
answerKey: studies — Ahmed is singular; change consonant + y to -ies.
enjoys — My mother is singular; enjoy ends in a vowel + y, so add -s.
cries — The baby singular and consonant before the letter -y
finishes — She - verb ends in -sh
drives — My father is singular.
helps — The teacher is singular.
tidies — He - consonant before the letter -y
shares — The little boy singular
studies — A good dtudent - singular and a consonant before the letter -y
carries — My brother - singular and consonant before the letter -y

lessons.title: الحصة 4 Ask questions with does
lessons.caption: 🎬 فيديو الحصة 4 | مستر مازن (eShool)
lessons.introMessage: يا هلا بيك! دي الحصة: الحصة 4. برسل ليك الفيديو والتمرين هسي 👇
lessons.taskMessage:
1. What ______ Ahmed ______ for breakfast every morning? (eat)
2. Where ______ Sara ______ English after school? (study)
3. When ______ your father ______ work every day? (start)
4. ______ Ali ______ football on Fridays? (play)
5. Why ______ the teacher ______ the lesson again? (explain)
6. What time ______ your sister ______ up every morning? (get)
7. How ______ Hassan ______ to school every day? (go)
8. ______ the bus ______ near your house every morning? (stop)
9. Where ______ Mary ______ her homework? (do)
10. How often ______ your brother ______ his room? (clean)
answerKey: does / eat — Use what to ask about a thing. After does, use eat, not eats.
does / study — Use where to ask about a place.
does / start — Use when to ask about time.
Does / play — This is a yes/no question, so no WH-word is needed.
does / explain — Use why to ask about a reason
does / get — Use what time to ask for a specific time.
does / go — Use how to ask about the way or means of travel.
Does / stop — This is a yes/no question. Use the base verb stop.
does / do — Use where to ask about a place. Here, do is the main verb.
does / clean — Use how often to ask about frequency.

lessons.title: الحصة الثانية: قاعدة أدوات الربط والشرط المتقدم (Conditionals & Connectors)
lessons.caption: 🎬 فيديو الحصة الثانية - الصف الثالث ثانوي | مستر مازن (eShool)
lessons.introMessage: ما شاء الله تبارك الله عليك! 🔥 بما إنك أتقنت الحصة الأولى وحليت تمرينها بنجاح، دي الحصة الثانية ليك لمتابعة التميز في الشهادة الثانوية هسي 👇
lessons.taskMessage:
1. Ahmed __________ to school by bus every morning. (go)

2. My mother __________ the dishes after dinner every day. (wash)

3. The teacher __________ the lesson clearly every time. (teach)

4. Sara __________ TV after finishing her homework. (watch)

5. My father __________ his car every weekend. (fix)

6. The bus __________ near our house every morning. (pass)

7. Hassan __________ his homework before he plays football. (do)

8. The goalkeeper __________ the ball carefully during every match. (catch)

9. A good student __________ carefully to the teacher every lesson. (listen)

10. The school bus __________ at the gate every afternoon. (reach)
answerKey: 1: goes
2: washes
3: teaches
4: watches
5: fixes
6: passes
7: does
8: catches
9: listens
10: reaches

lessons.title: الحصة الخامسة: نفي المضارع البسيط باستخدام do not
lessons.caption: 🎬 فيديو الحصة الخامسة - الصف الثالث ثانوي | مستر مازن (eShool)
lessons.introMessage: في الحصة الخامسة حنتمرن على نفي المضارع البسيط باستخدام do not مع I وyou وwe وthey والفاعل الجمع. ضفت ليك كمان مراجعة قصيرة من الحصة الأولى.
lessons.taskMessage:
📝 *تمرين الحصة الخامسة (Task 5): Present Simple Negative with do not*

كمّل الفراغ بالصيغة الصحيحة للفعلين الموجودين بين القوسين. في الأسئلة 1–11 استخدم *do not + الفعل الأساسي* فقط، من غير ما تضيف s للفعل. الأسئلة 12–15 مراجعة للمضارع البسيط المثبت مع الفاعل المفرد من الحصة الأولى.

1. We __________ (not / allocate) funds without proper approval.
2. The researchers __________ (not / disclose) preliminary findings to the public.
3. I __________ (not / assume) that the figures are final.
4. They __________ (not / negotiate) contract terms without legal advice.
5. You __________ (not / require) prior authorization for this section.
6. The employees __________ (not / submit) incomplete applications.
7. We __________ (not / postpone) the inspection without a valid reason.
8. The analysts __________ (not / identify) a consistent pattern in the data.
9. I __________ (not / recommend) an untested procedure.
10. They __________ (not / distribute) confidential documents by email.
11. You __________ (not / interpret) this clause in isolation.

*مراجعة من الحصة الأولى: المضارع البسيط المثبت مع المفرد*
12. The analyst __________ (interpret) the survey results carefully.
13. A responsible engineer __________ (maintain) the equipment regularly.
14. The new policy __________ (permit) students to use the library.
15. The manager __________ (confirm) the final schedule.

✍️ رسل لي إجاباتك مرقّمة من 1 إلى 15 عشان أراجعها ليك.
answerKey: 1. do not allocate — Use do not with we, followed by the base verb.
2. do not disclose — Use do not with a plural subject, followed by the base verb.
3. do not assume — Use do not with I, followed by the base verb.
4. do not negotiate — Use do not with they, followed by the base verb.
5. do not require — Use do not with you, followed by the base verb.
6. do not submit — Employees is a plural subject; use do not and the base verb.
7. do not postpone — Use do not with we, followed by the base verb.
8. do not identify — Analysts is a plural subject; use do not and the base verb.
9. do not recommend — Use do not with I, followed by the base verb.
10. do not distribute — Use do not with they, followed by the base verb.
11. do not interpret — Use do not with you, followed by the base verb.
12. interprets — Review: add -s to the verb with a singular subject.
13. maintains — Review: add -s to the verb with a singular subject.
14. permits — Review: add -s to the verb with a singular subject.
15. confirms — Review: add -s to the verb with a singular subject.

lessons.title: الحصة السابعة: Gerunds and Bare Infinitives
lessons.caption: 🎬 فيديو الحصة السابعة - الصف الثالث ثانوي | مستر مازن (eShool)
lessons.introMessage: في الحصة السابعة حنتمرن على الأفعال البتجي بعدها صيغة ing، والأفعال البتجي بعدها الفعل الأساسي من غير to.
lessons.taskMessage:
📝 *تمرين الحصة السابعة (Task 7):*

*Instructions: Complete each sentence with the correct form of the verb in brackets.*

1. She enjoys __________ English with her classmates. (practice)

2. The teacher made the students __________ the exercise again. (do)

3. My parents let me __________ my friends after school. (visit)

4. Ahmed avoids __________ computer games late at night. (play)

5. We look forward to __________ our new teacher. (meet)

6. The manager made the workers __________ the office before leaving. (clean)

7. He finished __________ his homework before dinner. (do)

8. My father lets me __________ his car on weekends. (use)

9. She suggested __________ the meeting until Monday. (postpone)

10. The coach made the players __________ for another thirty minutes. (run)

11. I can't stand __________ in long queues. (wait)

12. They let the children __________ outside after lunch. (play)
answerKey: 1: practicing
2: do
3: visit
4: playing
5: meeting
6: clean
7: doing
8: use
9: postponing
10: run
11: waiting
12: play
